# Browser utility dependencies

Pinned browser distributions fetched from the npm registry. Tarball SHA-512
integrity was verified before extracting only these assets and their licenses.
See manifest.json for exact versions, URLs, and hashes. No CDN is contacted by
the tools at runtime. Load QR libraries only on QR Code, PDF/ZIP libraries only
on PDF Tools, and diff only on Text Tools.

The 1,296-word passphrase list is EFF's short wordlist #1:
https://www.eff.org/files/2016/09/08/eff_short_wordlist_1.txt
Source and explanation: https://www.eff.org/dice
